limitations: Two scenario pathways only; composite method not reversible to inputs

name: Historical climate grids
limitations: Raw grids only, no derived statistics; access restriction must be resolved before publication

name: Vulnerability and adaptive capacity indicators
source_datasets: Proxy indicators across several catalog entries
limitations: No composite index exists; indicator coverage varies by area

name: Observation data held by other agencies
source_datasets: External - meteorological, space technology, marine and groundwater bodies
limitations: Not in DCCE catalog; every field unknown until an agreement exists

name: Climate phenomena monitoring
limitations: No monitoring feed exists; a source must be established, most likely external

name: Downscaled climate projections
limitations: National grid resolution, not the high-resolution sub-national product the requirement describes

name: Coastal and marine observations
limitations: Raw observations only; no rate of rise or erosion index derived; spatial resolution unrecorded

name: Historical disaster record
source_datasets: None in DCCE holdings; records across other bodies
limitations: Compilation task; sources exist but are scattered

name: Adaptation measures library
source_datasets: New - compiled from existing publications and new content
limitations: Cost information will be incomplete; measures must stay findable when cost is unknown

name: External portal connections
source_datasets: External - meteorological service, geo-informatics portal, Copernicus

limitations: Contains identifiable submitter information; retention and access rules needed before launch
